description: OTP and notification SMS: throughput, success/failure rates, and breakdowns by provider, template and failure reason.

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Accepted / (accepted + failed) over the selected range. Below ~95% means users are struggling to receive OTPs.

targets.expr:
100 * (sum(increase(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
  / clamp_min(
      (sum(increase(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
    + (sum(increase(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0)),
    1e-9)

panels.title: Failure Rate
panels.description: Share of SMS attempts that failed over the selected range.

targets.expr:
100 * (sum(increase(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
  / clamp_min(
      (sum(increase(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0))
    + (sum(increase(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__range])) or vector(0)),
    1e-9)

panels.title: Total Sent
panels.description: Accepted sends in the selected range.

panels.title: Total Failed
panels.description: Failed sends in the selected range.

panels.title: SMS Sent vs Failed (per minute)
panels.description: Delivery volume over time. A failure line that mirrors the sent line points at the provider, not at traffic.

targets.expr:
100 * (sum(rate(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
  / clamp_min((sum(rate(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

100 * (sum(rate(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
  / clamp_min((sum(rate(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

panels.title: Sent/min by Provider
panels.description: Throughput per aggregator (eskiz, playmobile, sayqal, log). Only one is active at a time unless SMS_PROVIDER changed mid-range.

panels.title: Failure Rate % by Provider
panels.description: Per-provider failure share — the panel that justifies switching SMS_PROVIDER during an incident.

targets.expr:
100 * (sum by (provider) (rate(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
  / clamp_min(
      (sum by (provider) (rate(mator_sms_sent_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
    + (sum by (provider) (rate(mator_sms_failed_total{instance=~"$instance", provider=~"$provider", template=~"$template"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)),
    1e-9)

panels.title: Sent/min by Template
panels.description: Volume per message type (otp, order_paid, …). "unknown" means the call site passed no template label.

panels.title: Volume by Provider & Template
panels.description: Sent and failed totals for the selected range, broken out by both labels.

panels.title: Failures/min by Reason
panels.description: Closed set of classified reasons. "timeout"/"network" point at the aggregator or the link; "auth" means credentials; "rate_limited" means we are sending too fast.

panels.title: Failure Reasons (selected range)
panels.description: Ranked failure causes, with the provider that produced them.

panels.title: SMS Queue Depth
panels.description: The sms queue that feeds delivery. Waiting growth here delays OTPs even when the provider is healthy.

panels.title: SMS Job Duration (P95)
panels.description: Time the SMS worker spends per job, including the provider HTTP call and its internal retries.

panels.title: Total SMS Cost
panels.description: Cumulative accounted SMS spend across all providers, summed from the SMS accounting table. Equals the sum of the per-provider panel beside it. Not affected by the dashboard time range: this is spend-to-date, not spend-in-window.

panels.title: SMS Cost by Provider
panels.description: Cumulative accounted spend per provider. One value per provider label, discovered automatically from the metric — a newly configured aggregator appears with no dashboard edit. Respects the Provider filter above.

title: Mator — SMS Delivery
